snippet.title: Y O U - Reveal + Sage Demo trailer
snippet.description:
https://gamejolt.com/games/YOU/1062872

One day while listening to the radio, you hear that there has been an alien invasion on earth. While this is just a minor inconvenience for most people, you feel as if You should do something about it. But where will You end up while doing this? Only you can find that out.

you take control of a fox - like creature to explore what's going on in this invasion. During this adventure, You may gain a connection with the player and grow stronger! Or you can ignore / shut down any communication.

Y O U, is a 3D Platforming game where things can change with every playthrough! Stage layouts, enemy types, and hazards always change! Sometimes you may encounter weird screaming dolls, and other times it could rain Jupiter! Something is always going on here!

DISCLAIMER:

This game features horror elements and themes, as well as the following:

-Disturbing imagery
-Flashing lights / effects
-Graphic imagery

if you are sensitive to any of this, I do not recommend playing.

(absolutely ***NO*** gen ai was used in the development of this game)

#yougame #indiegame #indiedev #weirdcore #dreamcore #weird
